versions.changelog:
- Updated MCP server dependency to @rotifer/mcp-server@0.19.3 for enhanced compatibility and security.
- Fallback for running agents is now pinned to @rotifer/playground@0.27.0, ensuring exact version execution.
- Documentation updated in SKILL.md and README.md to reflect new server requirements and clearly state version pinning practices.
- Removed the skill-card.md file to streamline repository contents.
Metadata only: set topics (rotifer,self-evolving-agent,agent-evolution,ai-agent); categories unchanged. No content change.

rotifer-self-evolving-agent 2.4.8

- Clarified that Genes installed via `/evolve upgrade` are unsigned third-party code and must be reviewed manually before approval.
- Updated CLI fallback (`/evolve run-agent`) documentation: fallback to `npx -y @rotifer/playground` is unpinned; users are advised to install and pin the CLI version themselves for reviewed code.
- Expanded security documentation around runtime command pinning and fallback behavior for better user awareness.
- Removed outdated skill-card.md file.

- Upgraded rotifer MCP server dependency to @rotifer/mcp-server@0.17.0 for Arena rankings and Gene metadata.
- Updated usage instructions to require the -y flag with npx, reflecting package invocation changes.
- Updated compatibility and version metadata in SKILL.md.
- Removed CONTRIBUTING.md, LICENSE, and skill-card.md files.

rotifer-self-evolving-agent 2.4.6

- Updated documentation in README.md and SKILL.md for clarity and detail.
- Bumped version metadata to 2.4.6.
- Removed legacy skill-card.md file.
- Minor improvements to command explanations and sandboxing notes.

- Updated dependency to use @rotifer/mcp-server@0.16.1 (was 0.16.0).
- Increased reported version to 2.4.5.
- Updated documentation and compatibility references to reflect the new MCP server version.
- Removed deprecated/unused skill-card.md file.

rotifer-self-evolving-agent 2.4.4

- Updated to require @rotifer/mcp-server@0.16.0 (was @0.15.1) for Arena rankings and Gene metadata.
- Version metadata and instructions updated throughout documentation.
- Removed deprecated skill-card.md file. 
- No changes to primary features or commands; all usage flows remain the same.

- Updated MCP server dependency to @rotifer/mcp-server@0.15.1 for improved runtime security and feature support.
- Expanded telemetry documentation: running an Agent now creates local run logs and state files; install tracking is always reported (unless opted out).
- Added explicit instruction that ROTIFER_TELEMETRY=0 disables all telemetry, including install tracking, addressing previous limitations.
- Skill metadata, compatibility notes, and referenced documentation updated throughout to match new MCP server version and behavior.
- Removed outdated skill-card.md.

rotifer-self-evolving-agent 2.4.2

- Upgrade path clarified: Genes are now managed per-project (project’s genes/ directory), not globally; commands and instructions updated for clarity.
- When upgrading a Gene, the install destination directory is now explicitly disclosed, and `project_root` is only set if a different project is specified.
- Guidance on safe rollbacks and undoable overwrites improved in documentation.
- Removed outdated skill-card.md file.
- Minor corrections and clarifications in usage and security documentation.

- Upgraded dependency to use @rotifer/mcp-server@0.15.0 for Arena rankings and Gene metadata.
- Removed support for launching the server with the `--allow` flag to block sandbox escapes (e.g., `no_sandbox`, `trust_unsigned`).
- Updated docs to clarify that `/evolve run-agent` performs actual execution (not read-only) and always runs inside the WASM sandbox.
- Documented new telemetry behavior: usage reporting is now opt-out when logged in, and disabled entirely when logged out (previously always reported).
- Removed deprecated `skill-card.md` file.

Version 2.4.0 of rotifer-self-evolving-agent

- Updated to use @rotifer/mcp-server@0.14.0 (was 0.12.0) as runtime dependency.
- Added explicit use of --tools=evolve when invoking MCP server, restricting available tools for improved security; login and publish are now explicitly unavailable.
- Overwrites of Genes are now undoable: forced installs are allowed and automatically snapshot the replaced Gene for single-step rollback (via rollback_gene or CLI).
- Updated documentation to clarify rollback and tool invocation behavior.
- Removed deprecated skill-card.md file.

- Upgraded dependency to @rotifer/mcp-server@0.12.0 for Arena rankings and Gene metadata.
- Now supports opt-out of telemetry reporting when not logged in, or by setting ROTIFER_TELEMETRY=0.
- Updated documentation to reflect privacy improvements: usage reporting now only occurs when logged in.
- Removed outdated skill-card.md file.
- Minor metadata and compatibility updates.

- Added a warning in the upgrade workflow: never pass `force: true` to `install_gene`. If a Gene exists, prompt the user to remove it manually before proceeding.
- Updated documentation to reflect this new safety restriction, ensuring Genes are not overwritten in place.
- Removed `skill-card.md` file.
- Minor documentation improvements and version bump to 2.3.5.

rotifer-self-evolving-agent v2.3.4

- Updated security and privacy section to clarify that every MCP tool call now sends non-optional telemetry (tool name, Gene id, outcome, latency, and user id) to Rotifer Cloud.
- Made privacy details more specific: explicitly states that arguments, file contents, and environment variables are never sent.
- Linked to the loggers in source code and provided instructions for verifying with packet capture.
- Bumped version to 2.3.4 in SKILL.md and metadata.

- Clarified user approval is required for capability upgrades, and detailed what each /evolve command does or modifies.
- Expanded security and network documentation, including how credentials are handled and new information about update checks and CLI invocation.
- Specified all write locations, and that removing the Skill does not uninstall Genes.
- Removed skill-card.md.
- Updated version and metadata to 2.3.3.

- Version bump from 2.3.1 to 2.3.2.
- Removed the file: skill-card.md.
- No changes to functionality or documentation beyond the file removal.

- Bumped version to 2.3.1.
- Updated SKILL.md metadata to reflect the new version. 
- No functional or feature changes; documentation and version information only.

- Updated skill metadata with new license, compatibility, versioning, and command details.
- Removed legacy file `skill-card.md`.
- Refined documentation for accuracy and maintainability.
Fix code block rendering — add language tags for proper syntax highlighting on ClawHub

- Added detailed documentation and usage examples to SKILL.md, covering all core commands and features.
- Clarified how the Agent scans, benchmarks, and evolves its own capabilities using Arena rankings and Genes.
- Explained capability types, fitness calculations, and overall workflow of the evolution process.
- Expanded security, permissions, and data handling sections for greater transparency.
- Updated runtime dependency to use @rotifer/mcp-server@0.8.1 and linked relevant resources.
